-- Top 50 SQL by elapsed time since instance start (V$SQLSTATS, no pack needed).
SELECT sql_id,
       executions,
       ROUND(elapsed_time / 1e6, 1)                          AS elapsed_s,
       ROUND(elapsed_time / NULLIF(executions, 0) / 1e3, 2)  AS ms_per_exec,
       buffer_gets,
       disk_reads,
       sql_text
FROM   v$sqlstats
ORDER  BY elapsed_time DESC
FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY;

args.sql:
-- Tablespace usage with severity computed in SQL, so the model reads a verdict.
SELECT tablespace_name,
       ROUND(used_percent, 1) AS used_pct,
       CASE WHEN used_percent >= 95 THEN 'CRITICAL'
            WHEN used_percent >= 85 THEN 'WARNING'
            ELSE 'OK' END AS severity
FROM   dba_tablespace_usage_metrics
ORDER  BY used_percent DESC;

calls.text:
"TABLESPACE_NAME","USED_PCT","SEVERITY"

args.sql:
-- Diagnostics Pack required. Top activity in the last 60 minutes from ASH.
SELECT sql_id, event, wait_class, COUNT(*) AS samples
FROM   v$active_session_history
WHERE  sample_time > SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '60' MINUTE
GROUP  BY sql_id, event, wait_class
ORDER  BY samples DESC
FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY;

-- Diagnostics Pack required. Latest 50 AWR snapshots.
SELECT snap_id, begin_interval_time, end_interval_time
FROM   dba_hist_snapshot
ORDER  BY snap_id DESC
FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY;
